text:
Thermal energy is transferred by conduction in a metal bar.
Which statement is not correct?
A
Fast vibrating ions leave the surface.
B
Free moving electrons carry thermal energy through the bar.
C
Ions vibrate and strike neighbouring ions to make them vibrate.
D
Ions vibrate but do not change position.

options.label: A
options.text: Fast vibrating ions leave the surface.

options.label: B
options.text: Free moving electrons carry thermal energy through the bar.

options.label: C
options.text: Ions vibrate and strike neighbouring ions to make them vibrate.

options.label: D
options.text: Ions vibrate but do not change position.
